elements.element: Renewal may occur only through either an automatic-renewal mechanism or an agreement-based renewal mechanism.
elements.evidence: The clause uses an automatic-renewal mechanism and provides no other unilateral renewal mechanism.

elements.element: If renewal is agreement-based rather than automatic, the renewal agreement must be mutual.
elements.evidence: The condition is absent because the rendered clause uses automatic renewal rather than agreement-based renewal.

elements.element: If renewal is agreement-based rather than automatic, the renewal agreement must be in writing.
elements.evidence: The condition is absent because the rendered clause uses automatic renewal rather than agreement-based renewal.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, each renewal term must be 12 months.
elements.evidence: The clause automatically renews for an additional one-year period on each anniversary.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer must be able to opt out on 30 days' notice.
elements.evidence: Either party, including the Company, may prevent or terminate renewal upon 30 days' written notice.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, Vendor must remind Customer of the upcoming renewal 60 days before renewal.
elements.evidence: HDI must notify the Company in writing of each upcoming automatic renewal not less than 60 days before the applicable anniversary.

elements.element: Any renewal price increase must be capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%.
elements.evidence: The added language expressly caps any renewal-period fee increase at the lesser of the increase in CPI and 3%.
The clause states that the Agreement automatically renews on each anniversary.

elements.element: Customer's non-renewal notice window must be no more than 60 days.
elements.evidence: The Company may give 30 days' written notice, which is no more than 60 days.

elements.element: Any renewal price increase must not exceed 5%.
elements.evidence: The lesser-of-CPI-and-3% cap cannot exceed 3% and therefore cannot exceed 5%.

result.reason: The automatic-renewal branch of the preferred position is fully implemented: one-year renewals, a 30-day Company exit right, a 60-day HDI reminder, and the required price cap. The fallback is also fully met. The changes are limited to the required notice period, reminder, and price cap and do not disturb unrelated terms. Drafting quality is reduced because the clause describes the 30-day right as termination rather than expressly as non-renewal and does not clearly tie the notice deadline to the anniversary, although the operative language still permits the Company to prevent renewal on 30 days' notice.
